summary: Tested Kanban Pipeline 7-Column Refactoring. All 13 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing confirms: All 7 columns render with correct labels (Cold Call, Build Interest, Interested/Waiting, Demo, Proposal Sent, Waiting on Leadership, Closed), horizontal flex scroll layout works, Stage dropdown in modal shows all 7 new stage names, Create Opportunity button works, drag-and-drop between columns works.

issues: Console warnings about DialogContent missing DialogTitle for accessibility - minor a11y issue (pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend VALID_STATUSES correctly defines 7 statuses: cold_call, build_interest, interested_waiting, demo, proposal_sent, waiting_leadership, closed
Backend STAGE_MAPPING correctly maps legacy stage names to new column IDs
Frontend COLUMNS array correctly defines 7 columns with matching IDs and labels
Frontend STAGE_OPTIONS correctly lists 7 stage names for dropdown
POST /api/leads/ correctly defaults to status='cold_call' via _map_stage_to_status()
PUT /api/leads/{id} preserves existing status (does NOT reset to 'opportunity')
PATCH /api/leads/{id}/status correctly validates against VALID_STATUSES and rejects invalid statuses
GET /api/leads/ returns JSON object with all 7 column keys
GET /api/leads/export/csv includes leads from all new statuses
Horizontal flex scroll layout (flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto) correctly shows all 7 columns
seed_data_creation: Test leads created and cleaned up during testing
